1.o: When Detective Moo Jin Hyuk's wife is brutally murdered, Kang Kwon Joo, an officer with superior auditory abilities, listens on the other end of the 911 call. Three years later, Jin Hyuk and Kwon Joo find themselves working together.

2.o: Jin Hyuk rushes to get to Bok Rim before it's too late. Kwon Joo compiles officers with varying expertise for her Golden Time Team.

3.o: Time is running out for Ah Ram as Kwon Joo tries to decipher the xylophone sound. Kwon Joo tells Jin Hyuk her side of what happened three years ago.

4.t: Dark Generic Bell Sound: The Secret of the Chocolate Box (1)
4.o: When Go Dong Chul's death is ruled a suicide, Kwon Joo realizes she must take things into her own hands. Jin Hyuk hurries to find the victim, whom he knows personally, of a kidnapping case.

5.t: Dark Generic Bell Sound: The Secret of the Chocolate Box (2)
5.o: The clock is rapidly ticking for Kwon Joo as her captors prepare to bury her alive. Meanwhile, Eun Byul's own life is in danger as she's hidden in a location unknown to the police.

6.t: Secret of the Trash House: The Pupil in the Wall (1)
6.o: Kyung Il reveals to Kwon Joo that he witnessed her father's murder. Jin Hyuk and Kwon Joo go off on their own, feeling closer than ever to finding the perpetrator.

7.t: Secret of the Trash House: The Pupil in the Wall (2)
7.o: When a dead body falls out of a supposed victim's closet, Jin Hyuk and Kwon Joo realize the case goes much deeper than they had initially expected.

8.t: Secret of the Trash House: The Pupil in the Wall (3)
8.o: Jin Hyuk tries to escape the clutches of Good Friend, who don't quite live up to their name. The hunt for the perpetrator continues, but he is not an easy target.

9.t: Secret of the Trash House: The Pupil in the Wall (4)
9.o: An accusatory post about Hyun Ho appears online. The Center receives multiple calls when a night club suddenly turns into a nightmare.

10.o: Yang Ho Shik ambushes Eun Soo while Jin Hyuk and Dae Shik are led astray. Things become even more personal when Dong Woo is put in danger.

11.o: The elusive Nam Sang Tae prepares to flee the country, but the police are determined not to let him get away this time. A 911 call brings the Golden Time Team to a hostage situation on a rooftop.

12.t: A Call From the Fiery Pit
12.o: Kwon Joo realizes they may have written off Baek Jin Gu's claims too quickly. Later, she finds troubling information related to the Eunhyung-dong case.

13.o: Jin Hyuk goes to meet Nam Sang Tae by himself, hoping for answers. Kwon Joo looks deeper into the relationship between Ji Hye, Kong Chul Hwan, and GP Development.

14.o: All hell breaks loose when Kwon Joo recognizes Tae Gu's voice. A serious bus accident threatens the lives of many, including a pregnant woman and a child.

15.o: As gas continues to leak from the bus, the chance of an explosion heightens. Jin Hyuk must face the undeniable truth about Dae Shik.

16.o: Jin Hyuk and Kwon Joo sneak into Tae Gu's killing lair, unaware Dae Shik is inside. Can they capture the crazed murderer before he escapes? Find out in the thrilling series finale.

1.o: يواصل "فريق الوقت الذهبي" مكافحة الجريمة بشدّة، ويستجيب لتهديد بوجود قنبلة في مترو الأنفاق، لكن القائد "كيونغ هاك" لم يصل إلى مسرح الجريمة.

2.o: بعدما تقتنع "غوانجو" أن المشتبه به لم يكن بمفرده، تفكّر في خطوتها التالية وأفضل سبل السيطرة على المحقق "كانغو" الذي لا يمكن التنبؤ بأفعاله.

3.o: يُتَّهم مُعتدٍ جنسي أُطلق سراحه مؤخّرًا بجريمة اختطاف. وبينما يتّجه "كانغو" إلى مسرح الجريمة، يصادف الرجل الذي يعتقد أنه يلاحقه.

4.o: يموت مشتبه به أثناء الاحتجاز بسبب ما يبدو أنه أزمة قلبية. ولاحقًا، يتلقّى "كانغو" رسالة من العقل المدبّر الحقيقي المراوغ.

5.o: يتحرّك "كانغو" وفريقه لإنقاذ زوجة "بارك" من خاطفها، لكنهم يصطدمون بوحدة كبير المفتشين "نا"، التي تطارد الرجل نفسه أيضًا.

6.t: The Accomplices with the Star Coins (1)
6.o: يبدأ "فريق الوقت الذهبي" التحقيق مع كبير المفتشين "نا"، ولكن حين يفرط عضو في الحماسة في بحثه، ينتهي الأمر بتنبيه الشخص المستهدف عن دون قصد.

7.t: The Accomplices with the Star Coins (2)
7.o: يُقسِم مدوّن فيديو شهير أنه واجه فتاة زومبي تستمرّ في مهاجمة المزيد من الأشخاص، فيما يتحرّك المحقّقون المتشكّكون لكشف الحقيقة.

8.o: يلقي المفتش "نا" بذور الشكّ في عقل "غوانجو" بإخبارها بشأن ماضي "كانغو" ونوبات فقدان الذاكرة، بينما تتعرّض "أونسو" للتهديد من حبيب سابق.

9.o: في ظلّ شكوك الفريق أن "أونسو" قد يكون لها يد في طعن ضحيّة، يُلقي القبض على المشتبه بهما، ولكن يلاحظون دليلًا على وجود شريكة أخرى في الجريمة.

10.o: تشير الأدلة إلى أن "نا" في خطر. ولاحقًا، يُشاهد رجل مصاب يشبه "كانغو" يعرج مبتعدًا عن مسرح جريمة دموية، حيث يُعثَر على بطاقة هويّة "نا".

11.o: بعدما زال الشكّ عنه، يكشف "كانغو" عن ماضيه المؤسف لـ"غوانجو". ولاحقًا، يهاجم السفاح الحقيقي "سيول" ويعطي "غوانجو" إنذارًا نهائيًا.

12.t: Era of Hate: For the Golden Time Team!
12.o: يسلِّم "جيسو" نفسه، ممّا يؤدي إلى مواجهة محتدمة مع "كانغو". أمّا حيلة "جيسو" غير المتوقّعة، فتدفع "غوانجو" و"كانغو" إلى اتخاذ موقف.

1.o: Kang Kwon Joo is still recovering from the explosion that severely injured her.

2.t: An Evil Lives in Shishiodoshi Ryokan!
2.o: Soon after meeting with Kang Woo, the team gets a call from a tourist. She says a psychopath kidnapped her and is about to kill her

3.o: Kang Woo returns to Korea and reports to the higher ups about what he has been doing and the cartel that is behind Doctor Fabre

4.o: The Golden Time Team gets a call about a kid named Pyo Hyun Soo. He is a kid suffering from Asperger's syndrome. However, his guardian, Song Soo Cheol, seems to be manipulating Hyun Soo

5.o: Je Soo is able to escape after faking a suicide. Soon after his escape, he comes across someone. Even when the Golden Time Team responds immediately, they lost Je Soo

6.o: The perpetrator that shot poisonous darts has been apprehended. She reveals she wanted revenge for what Director Cheon has done to her

7.o: Hong Soo catches Kang Woo interrogating Burying Beetle at Port Poongsan. While trying to stop Kang Woo, Burying Beetle gets away. However, not everything is for naught, as Kang Woo now knows a clue related to Wire Shun. Meanwhile, the Golden Time Team gets a call from a man saying someone drunk or high has beaten him up.

8.o: A man suspected of being Wire Shun, Fujiyama Koichi, is located at Club Blackhole. Although Kang Woo chases after him, Fujiyama gets away. Moreover, the police lose Jin Sik while he went to the bathroom. After inspecting the bathroom, Kang Woo suspects someone has kidnapped Jin Sik. Meanwhile, Cho Rong searches more about Fujiyama and comes across important information on Kang Woo.

9.o: While searching through the area, the perpetrator makes Kang Woo turn and attack Kwon Joo. She confirms that Kang Woo is unstable and asks him to turn his gun and police badge in. The Dispatch Team finds the dead bodies of Fujiyama and his henchman. Kang Woo suspects there is someone else who controlled Fujiyama and believes this case is far from over.

10.o: The team arrives at Dr. Hwang’s Clinic and apprehends Choo Dong Goo, who has been causing a scene. Dong Goo claims Doctor Hwang hid his soon-to-be wife, Se Mi, and something horrible has happened to her. Although Kang Woo said he wouldn’t meddle in today’s case, he spots blood in the operation room. He realizes something is off and thinks Se Mi got kidnapped.

11.o: Yukiko’s husband, Kaneki Masayuki, seems like an amazing professor loved by his students who stand up for human rights. Kwon Joo and Kang Woo come across him while checking on Fujiyama Koichi’s autopsy. Meanwhile, Goto Naomi, a worker who worked for Yukiko, finds a camera installed in one of the paintings that recorded the day Yukiko got murdered.

12.o: Soon after Naomi brought the painting and the camera, she gets killed. Her body was displayed just like the painting she had brought which makes the Golden Time Team think it was done by someone related to Auction Fabre. Meanwhile, Kang Woo quits his job and tries to go after the perpetrator by his way.

13.o: While searching the Blackhole Club, Hong Soo gets ambushed and abducted by one of Kaneki’s henchman. Thankfully, even while his hands are tied, Hong Soo gives the team some information. With the information, the team locates where Hong Soo is. Kang Woo gets to the location before the team arrives and goes after the abductor.

14.o: Hong Soo gets tortured and murdered by Jeon Chang Soo. Due to this incident, police headquarters decide to disband the Golden Time Team. The team, however, gets a few days to catch the real owner of Auction Fabre. Meanwhile, Kang Woo is going solo and tries to figure out why Professor Kaneki is so obsessed with him.

15.o: Dispatch Team heads over to the location Kang Woo confined Chang Soo. But when they arrive at the place, Chang Soo is found dead. Meanwhile, Kang Woo is trying to find out about Kaneki’s past and goes to an old maid that worked at the Kaneki household in the past. The information the maid gives is rather shocking and makes Kang Woo remember his past.

16.t: Kaneki Is Stowing Away To Japan
16.o: After obtaining Kaneki’s cellphone, the Golden Time Team locates where Kaneki went frequently. There, the team finds Congressman Makio along with the rotting bodies. But not long after such discovery, poisonous gas starts fill the building up. Meanwhile, Kaneki is heading over to his hideout, and the team thinks he is stowing away to Japan.

1.o: Strange emails are sent to Kwon Joo. She thinks they’re just prank emails, but soon, she realizes the emails have been forewarning her of murders. She starts to track down who sent the emails. Meanwhile, Derek Cho, a detective from the U.S., is working temporarily in Korea. He has a younger sister who has a speech impediment, but she’s abducted and in danger.

2.o: Kwon Joo and Derek finally meet in person at the Vimo Provincial Police Agency. However, when Derek checks the suspect’s face on the CCTV footage from the airport, he does not hesitate to point his gun at Kwon Joo. Meanwhile, a call comes in about a mysterious wild animal that dragged a person off in Mosim Forest.

3.t: The Phone Call From The Victim
3.o: The call center receives a phone call from the missing woman, Jang Ye Sook. Kwon Joo tries her best to hear anything over the phone that might help the team get to Ye Sook in time. Meanwhile, Derek, who joins the Golden Time Team, finds a piece of clothing with a bite mark on it. The team puts all of their effort into saving the victim before it is too late.

4.o: The Golden Time Team heads to the hospital in search of the fleeing suspect, Gong Su Ji. Meanwhile, Han Woo Ju, a cyber agent who runs the fansite for the Golden Time Team, brings in a helpful clue. Then, a call center receives a report about a haenyeo who claims to have seen her granddaughter’s dead body in a cauldron in the sea.

5.o: Kwon Joo’s team and Derek continue to look for Su Ji and Ga Eun. Su Ji’s belongings and what seems to be her will are found near the beach, and the local police officers assume that Su Ji committed suicide. Meanwhile, Ga Eun who was abducted by the drug smugglers tries to run away, risking her life.

6.o: Kwon Joo’s profiling leads to the conclusion that the Circus Man is in fact a man with multiple personalities. Derek and the Golden Time Team continue questioning the suspect as Dae Shik rejoins the dispatch team. Meanwhile, a call comes into the 112 call center from a man who is being chased by someone with a knife. Kwon Joo sends the Golden Time Team to the scene.

7.o: Kang Man Ho’s father, Kang Seok Chun, is supposedly dead on paper. However, he is still alive, and his hidden story comes to light. Meanwhile, Derek hears the truth from Director Yang about his mom’s death 28 years ago. Also, Woo Ju sets up a trap online to catch the Circus Man. Meanwhile, a mysterious user approaches him.

8.o: The Golden Time Team conducts a discreet operation to catch the user they believe to be Circus Man. Meanwhile, Eun Soo volunteers to transfer to the dispatch team. As they chase down Circus Man, a local high school teacher calls the 112 Call Center about his student who has gone missing after leaving an ominous voicemail.

9.o: Derek and Dae Shik finally catch the man who is suspected to have abducted and confined Saet Byul and Hyo Joon in a motel room. But he says he was also forced by a woman for money. Eun Soo manages to enter the motel and finds a path that leads to a hidden room. Meanwhile, Kwon Joo bumps into a stranger in a stairway, but she instantly recognizes him by his voice.

10.o: The man who Kwon Joo bumped into in the stairway was Dong Bang Min. He threatens Kwon Joo with a knife. Fortunately, Derek and Dae Sik arrive to save Kwon Joo. Dong Bang Min soon gets released thanks to the connection between the Commissioner General and his grandfather, the head of Sonang Village. Meanwhile, Kwon Joo and Derek find out more about Joo Bum Tae from his schoolmate. And they also hear about a kidnapper who is quite short.

11.o: The Golden Time Team arrests and interrogates Kwak Man Taek, the man who works for Dong Bang Min, after he confesses that he is the Circus Man. However, during the interrogation, he has a seizure and acts very strangely. Meanwhile, Kwon Joo figures something out while analyzing Dong Bang Min’s many voices. Then, someone breaks into the Golden Time Team’s lodgings.

12.o: Kwon Joo and Derek chase after the person who snuck into the dorm. Kwon Joo sees something from a past dream that she had. Derek saves her from imminent danger, and they find out why they both saw strange visions. As the secrets of Sonang Village slowly come to light, Woo Ju informs the team that Saet Byeol has disappeared from the shelter.

1.t: Those Who Are Destined to Meet
1.o: تتولّى طبيبة زمام الأمور حين يرفض لصوص أن تعالجهم لأنها امرأة. ويَندُر مصادفةُ معلّمٍ جيد... ولكن يبدو أن "هيي جيونغ" محظوظة.

2.o: تقابل "هيي جيونغ" وجوهًا مألوفة في المدرسة وتتعرّف على صديقة جديدة. وفي أثناء معالجة إحدى حالات الطوارئ، تكتشف شيئًا عن "جي هونغ" وعن نفسها.

3.o: يقرّر "جي هونغ" الرحيل، وتزداد الأمور سوءًا عندما تتجاوز غيرة "سيو يو" الحدود. وتواجه "هيي جيونغ" مزيدًا من المتاعب، رغم تضحية صديقتها.

4.o: يثير قرار "هيي جيونغ" بإجراء عمليّة جراحيّة عاجلة في أول يوم زمالة لها غضب طبيب آخر، بينما ينبهر صديق قديم بمهاراتها.

5.o: ما التسامح؟ يضع "يون دو" "هيي جيونغ" في موقف صعب، وتقبل "هيي جيونغ" أن تكون تلميذة لـ "جي هونغ" مجددًا... وما زالت "سيو يو" غارقة في الماضي.

6.o: ينتظر البعض مرور العاصفة ويناضل البعض الآخر في معترك الحياة، فيما تستقبل "هيي جيونغ" زائرة غير مرغوب بها وتطلب منها المساعدة.

7.o: يلتئم شمل "هيي جيونغ" بصديقها القديم "سو تشيول" الذي يُذكّرها بالأياّم الخوالي، ويُهدّد استعراض للقوة بجلب تغيير غير مرغوب فيه إلى المستشفى.

8.o: تقطع "هيي جيونغ" عهدًا لصديق وتمرّ بأصعب أيّامها في العمليّات الجراحيّة، فيما يتّخذ "يون دو" موقفًا وتُصرّ "سيو يو" على أنّها الضحيّة.

9.o: تتلقّى "هيي جيونغ" هديّة فاخرة، ويتصارح "يون دو" مع "جي هونغ"، وتتبنّى "سيو يو" إستراتيجية جديدة، وتضرب الأنباء السيّئة "جي هونغ" بشكل شخصي.

10.o: تتّحد "هيي جيونغ" و"يون دو" لإجراء جراحة مهمّة، كما ترفض "هيي جيونغ" مُساعدة "جي هونغ" في شأن شخصيّ لكنّها تكتشف أنّ عملها في خطر.

11.t: What Real Love Does to You
11.o: يظهر أحد أصدقاء "جي هونغ" القدامى، وتعرف "هيي جيونغ" بنتيجة التحقيقات، بينما ينتاب "سيو يو" القلق من جرّاء نصيحة والدها.

12.o: تريد "هيي جيونغ" النصيحة من "يون دو"، ويتعامل "جي هونغ" مع نكسة شخصيّة ولكنّ "هيي جيونغ" تجهل كيف تساعده وتتعامل المستشفى مع شخص مُطارِد.

13.o: تتعلّم "هيي جيونغ" و"جي هونغ" كيف يصبحان جزءًا من حياة شخص ما، ويعجز "يون دو" عن التخلّص من الزوار غير المرغوبين، وتضرب فضيحة أخرى المستشفى.

14.o: يسعى "جي هونغ" إلى معرفة المزيد عن مُلابسات وفاة والده، بينما يعتني الطاقم الطبّي بأخوين مريضين، وتطلب "هيي جيونغ" إجابات عن تساؤلاتها.

15.o: تتشاور "هيي جيونغ" مع "يون دو" بشأن مريضة جديدة، ويلجأ "يون دو" إلى منزل "جي هونغ"، فيما تتصادم "هيي جيونغ" مع "جي هونغ" حول رأي طبّيّ.

16.o: تُواجه "هيي جيونغ" مزيدًا من المشاكل بعد تفاقم حالة مريض ذي أهمّيّة. وعندما يُحاول "يون دو" تقديم المساعدة، تُدرك "غانغ سو" أمرًا مروّعًا.

17.o: تمثُل "هيي جيونغ" أمام اللجنة التأديبيّة، وتكتشف أنّ تسليط الضوء على الحقيقة قد يطول به الزمن.

18.o: تسمح "هيي جيونغ" لمشاعرها بالتأثير في حكمها، ويوجّه "ميونغ هون" تهديدات جديدة، ويحقق "جي هونغ" و"تاي هو" و"يون دو" في شؤون المستشفى المالية.

19.o: يتلقّى "يون دو" دعوة عشاء من "جي هونغ"، وتذهب "هيي جيونغ" لزيارة جدّتها، وتُجبر الاكتشافات الجديدة "سيو يو" على التصالح مع نفسها.

20.o: يتردّد "جي هونغ" و"هيي جيونغ" عندما يحتاج مريض بمرض خطير تربطهما به علاقة شخصية إلى عملية جراحية، وتقرّر "هيي جيونغ" المضيّ قدمًا في حياتها.

1.o: في إطار درامي رومانسي تدور الأحداث حول فتاة ظلت محتفظة بسر حبها ﻷحد الأشخاص أكثر من عشر سنوات ثم قررت أن تفصح عنه بطريقتها الخاصة

1.t: My Senpai Is a Bunny Girl
1.o: Puberty syndrome – Abnormal experiences rumored on the internet to be caused by sensitivity and instability during adolescence. This year, Sakuta Azusagawa, a second-year student at a high school near Enoshima, meets several girls that are experiencing this “puberty syndrome.” For instance, he meets a wild bunny girl in the library. She turns out to be an actress on hiatus, Mai Sakurajima, who is also his senior at the school. For some reason, no one else can see this enchanting girl. How did she become invisible…? As Sakuta searches for answers to help Mai, they spend more time together, and

2.t: On First Dates, Trouble Is Essential
2.o: While looking for the cause of Mai's Adolescence Syndrome, Sakuta ends up scheduling a date with Mai. On the day they promised, Sakuta tries to help out a lost little girl on his way towards Fujisawa Station. But, he is misunderstood to be a perverted maniac by another girl, and because of that, he ends up arriving late to his appointed time to meet Mai. He somehow gains Mai's forgiveness and they proceed with their date, but Mai changes their destination, and takes Sakuta to Shichirigahama Beach...

3.o: Even after leaving Fujisawa for Ogaki, not one person remembered anything about Mai Sakurajima. Sakuta and Mai return to school together, but even there they hear from Sakuta's friend Rio Futaba that nobody at school outside of her has any recollection about Mai. At the same time, Sakuta hears of a theory that losing memories concerning Mai is based on a certain action taken, and struggles so that he doesn't lose his memories of her. And seeing Sakuta act as such, Mai makes a certain decision of her own as well...

4.t: There Is No Tomorrow for a Rascal
4.o: Soon after Mai's "puberty syndrome" is resolved, Sakuta encounters another strange phenomenon without respite. Day after day, it is the same day for Sakuta and there is no tomorrow. When he consults Rio, she raises the possibility of "Laplace’s demon" -- that someone may be repeating and redoing a day.

5.t: All the Lies I Have for You
5.o: Because of the misunderstanding that she was dating Sakuta, Tomoe is able to resolve the agonizing situation of being asked out by the guy her friend is in love with. She pleads with Sakuta to continue acting like they are dating. Despite feeling indebted to Mai, Sakuta could not leave Tomoe alone as she was fearing that she would lose her presence within her class. So, he reluctantly agrees to play the role of Tomoe's fake boyfriend for a while.

6.o: It is now the last day of the first term, the promised day when pretending to be dating Tomoe ends. It seems as though everything has finally been resolved, but…

7.o: After agreeing to harbor an abandoned cat, Sakuta finds himself welcoming a look-alike to his old school crush into his home. This does not sit very well with Mai, who is trying her best to be with her boyfriend amidst a demanding work schedule. Meanwhile, something appears to be up with Futaba...

8.t: Wash It All Away on a Stormy Night
8.o: Upon inducing a case of "Puberty Syndrome" where two copies of herself exists, Rio ends up staying at Sakuta's house for the time being. Meanwhile, "the other Rio" has been busy posting various unexpected photos on social media. After being informed about these activities by his classmate, Saki Kamisato, Sakuta decides to have a chat with "the other Rio." As he learns more about each of the Rio-s in hopes of discovering the reason for "the other Rio’s" actions and possibly a cure for her "Puberty Syndrome," Sakuta begins to realize the troubles each of them carries...

9.o: Sakuta had been unable to see Mai, who was not only busy with work but had an order from her agency forbidding her from going on dates. The second term finally begins, and Sakuta is eagerly looking forward to seeing Mai again at school. But upon seeing Mai in front of his house, she greets him with a shocking, "Who the heck are you?" Upon confirming what the circumstances are, it comes into light that Mai and her little sister Nodoka Toyohama have swapped bodies. Until this new Adolescence Syndrome is resolved, Mai will be living as Nodoka, and Nodoka will be living as Mai...

10.o: Unable to deal with a commercial filming well as the actress Mai Sakurajima, Nodoka gradually starts to feel a strong sense of inferiority. As their body-swapped lives continues on, the day arrives where Mai must perform in Nodoka's pop idol group "Sweet Bullet". Sakuta and Nodoka attend the concert as they were given tickets...

11.o: With Nodoka's Puberty Syndrome resolved, Sakuta's expectations to spend sweeter times with Mai is growing. But then, a scandal is reported by the media about Mai Sakurajima having a new boyfriend. In the press conference for a movie she had a role in, Mai gives a sincere explanation. Seeing that, Kaede decides to set goals for the rest of the year, wanting to do her best for Sakuta's sake as well. One of the goals she writes down is to go back to school...

12.o: Sakuta unveils to Mai and Nodoka the details of his family's past, and the trauma that Kaede underwent. Meanwhile, Kaede continues her re-integration into society, but as more hurdles appear, Sakuta worries for his sister's well-being.

13.t: The Dawn After an Endless Night
13.o: With Sakuta's help, Kaede is able to go to school at night. She is now enthusiastic about heading to school during the day. However, on the following day, the original Kaede's memory suddenly returns, eradicating all memories of the Kaede that had spent the last two years together with Sakuta. A certain person appears before Sakuta, who is overwhelmed with grief because Kaede was no longer around.

2.o: يسعى "براد" لإطلاق لعبة هاتف. تُضطر "بوبي" للتوقف عن العمل على التوسيع مع "أيان"، للتحدث في اجتماع للسيدات في مجال الألعاب.

3.o: يعمل "أيان" و"بوبي" بشكل منفصل على التوسيع، بينما "جو" تساعد "سي دبليو" على التعامل مع الناشر، ويحاول "براد" إيجاد شريكة لـ"ديفيد".

4.o: يحاول "براد" إقناع فريق التطوير بأن أخاه "زاك" ليس باللطف الذي يتظاهر به. تسدي "ريتشل" خدمة لـ"أيان".

5.o: تجادل "كارول" موظفي "ميثيك كويست" لرفضهم توقيع نتائج تقييم بسيط لبيئة العمل.

6.o: يكتشف شاب يافع ما يتطلبه الأمر ليصبح أحد أعظم كتّاب الخيال العلمي.

7.o: "ريتشل" ترافق "سي دبليو" في زيارته القاسية لصديقه السابق وعدوه الحالي.

8.o: يقدم "أيان" جزءه الخاص من التوسيع وينتهي به الحال في المستشفى. يتساءل "ديفيد" عن إرثه الذي سيتركه.

9.o: يتعاون "أيان" و"بوبي" مجدداً، تكتشف "ريتشل" و"دانا" الخطوة التالية في علاقتهما، ويسعى "براد" لتسوية خلاف بشكل حاسم.

1.o: يدير "ديفيد" شركة "ميثيك كويست"، بينما يدرس "أيان" و"بوبي" عروضاً تلقياها عن تطوير لعبة متشعبة. تلم "جو" شمل الفريق بالكامل من أجل الاحتفال بـ"سي دبليو".

2.o: يشعر "أيان" بالانسياق في شراكته الجديدة مع "بوبي"، وتنتاب "ديفيد" و"جو" مخاوف بشأن عودة موظف سابق. تلتقي "دانا" و"ريتشل" مختبري الألعاب الجديدين.

3.o: يستغل "ديفيد" أخباراً مثيرة بشأن "إم كيو" بغرض إثارة الغيرة في نفس "أيان"، و"بوبي" و"ريتشل" و"جو" يخرجن لتناول الفطور المتأخر.

4.o: عندما يعلق "ديفيد" في زحام المرور، تحل "جو" مكانه وتقابل ممثلاً شهيراً لتأدية دور في الفيلم. يحاول "براد" أن يساعد "كارول" في جني المال من خلال الرموز غير القابلة للاسترداد.

5.o: تستمع "بوبي" على مضد إلى رأي "دانا" عن عملها، بينما تعيش "كارول" و"براد" و"ريتشل" عواقب المناورة الخاصة بتوليد الأرباح التي خططوا لها معاً.

6.o: في أول موسم عطلات منذ رحيل "أيان" و"بوبي"، يمسك "ديفيد" بزمام الأمور ويحاول بث روح الـ"كريسماس" في نفوس الموظفين.

7.o: صبيان من النصف الآخر من العالم يجدان شغفهما في عالم لا يفهمهما.

8.o: الصدام الذي وقع بين "أيان" و"بوبي" بشأن تفضيلاتهما في المكتب يضعهما في خلاف، بينما يتعاون "جو" و"براد" في التخلص من آفات مكتب "ديفيد".

9.o: جلسة "ديفيد" و"جو مانغانيلو" عن المحتوى السينمائي المتحرك تتعرض للسطو الفكري، بينما "دانا" تساعد "بوبي" في الاستعداد لتقديم عرض تسويق فكرة "بلايبن" على مستثمر مجازف.

10.o: يحاول "أيان" أن يصلح علاقته بـ"بوبي"، بينما يسلك "ديفيد" طريقاً مسدوداً في رحلة صنع الفيلم، ويتفتح وعي "دانا" إلى أفق جديدة بشأن "غريمبوب".

1.o: يكشف "أيان" و"بوبي" عن مشروعيهما بينما يعانيان مع الحدود الشخصية والمهنية. يتأقلم فريق "ميثيك كويست" على النمو الجديد للعبتهم.

2.o: يستخدم "ديفيد" الذكاء الاصطناعي لضبط سلوك اللاعبين، والذكاء الاصطناعي بدوره يحتاج إلى البشر لضبطه. في تلك الأثناء، لا يُوجد من يضبط الجدال بين "أيان" و"بوبي".

3.o: ينطلق "أيان" و"ديفيد" و"جو" في رحلة يوم لاكتشاف الذات. يقدم "براد" درساً لـ"دانا" و"ريتشل" عن المسؤولية المالية.

4.o: يدعو مُضيف غامض فريق "إم كيو" إلى حفل لحل لغز جريمة القتل في جزيرة خاصة.

5.o: تتصارع "بوبي" مع اكتشافها بينما يحاول "أيان" مساعدتها بطريقته المميزة. تواجه "دانا" منافسة غير متوقعة.

6.o: عندما تصبح علاقة "دانا" بـ"إم كيو" مصدر تهديد لخطة إصدار لعبة جديدة، يضع "براد" خطة لخدعة طويلة الأمد لمساعدتها. تقيم "جو" حفلاً من أجل "بوبي".

7.ar: الغرفة التي يحدث فيها كل شيء
7.o: يتعرّض "ديفيد" و"ريتشل" للفحص الدقيق بسبب "بلايبن". تتخذ "دانا" قراراً صعباً. محاولة "أيان" لمساعدة "بوبي" لا تسير كما خطط لها.

8.o: يحاول "بوتي شو" تغيير هويته بتحدي خصم في معركة للفنون المختلطة.

9.o: بينما تفكر "بوبي" في تنفيذ تغيير جذري بحياتها، يحاول "ديفيد" إنقاذ "إم كيو".

10.o: يصل زائر غير متوقع من "مونتريال" لتقييم "إم كيو". يواجه "أيان" و"بوبي" قراراً مصيرياً.

2.o: يشن الثري هجومًا مضادًا بينما تجمع الشرطة كمًّا هائلًا من الأدلة ضده. لكن كيف جمع الثروة التي حمته كل هذا الوقت؟

3.o: يعقد الثري صفقة إقرار بالذنب غير مسبوقة في تساهلها، وتكشف إحدى الناجيات الأهوال التي عاشتها على جزيرته الخاصة.

4.o: بعد اعتقاله واتهامه عام 2019 بالاتجار بالقاصرات، لا يمضي الثري خلف القضبان سوى وقت قصير، لكن من اتهمنه ينلن يومهن في المحكمة.

1.o: Aoi Ashito is an ace of a weak soccer team at a junior high school in Ehime. His play almost gets the team to the semi-final in his last tournament in junior high, but provoked by the opponent’s goalie, Ashito receives a red card and is removed from the game. While Ashito is running on the beach to forget the frustration, mysterious Fukuda Tatsuya, who calls himself the manager of Tokyo City Esperion Youth team, approaches Ashito.

2.o: At Fukuda’s invitation and with the support of Shun, Ashito goes to Tokyo alone for the tryouts of Tokyo City Esperion Youth team. Thoroughly impressed with Esperion’s facility, Ashito is escorted to the tryouts by Hana Ichijo, Fukuda’s sister-in-law. Among the 86 candidates of notable achievements, Ashito has no outstanding records. Nervous as he is, Ashito is excited to be able to play soccer on the beautiful field.

3.t: The Final Stage of Assessment Begins
3.o: The final test turns out to be a game with the Esperion Youth team. Fukuda tells the candidates that he will give a piece of information to them during the game. While other candidates feel overwhelmed, Ashito is eager to beat the Youth team so everyone can pass the test. The candidates feel good about the game, but start to feel uneasy at the Youth team's sluggish play.

4.o: While the candidates are overwhelmed by the youth team, Fukuda rubs salt into the wound by telling them a piece of information. Unable to recover from the shock, the candidate team allows more goals to the youth team, making it a one-sided match. While his teammates feel completely beaten and lose their fighting spirit, Ashito, still feeling the pain from Akutsu's attack, starts to lose his will to fight.

5.o: The letter of acceptance arrives to Ashito in Ehime. Ashito and his friends are overjoyed at the news, but Noriko, Ashito’s mom, looks at the celebration with mixed feelings. Hana tells Ashito to have a heart-to-heart with Noriko, but he never gets the chance until the day of his departure.

6.o: Ashito arrives at Esperion's base, meets fellow test participants and meets future teammates. However, the team's coaching staff promises not to give an easy life to the players' desires.

7.o: Fukuda suggests that Ashito and other new Esperion Youth players play an intrasquad game. Anyone who proves their worth in the game will be promoted to the A team. All new players are excited at the prospect of joining the A team. Ashito, playing his favorite forward position, starts the game out well. However…

8.o: The intrasquad game will determine who gets promoted to the A team. However, no one is passing the ball to Ashito, who is not able to communicate with his teammates through his soccer. He stands in the middle of the field, unable to do anything. Date says that Ashito lacks "individual tactics" to keep up with the constant change of play. Akutsu, a senior player who attacked Ashito at the tryouts, appears in front of him after the game.

9.o: Ashit who can't easily master the basic soccer movement of "stop and kick". Togashi, who is in the same room, tells the true meaning of "stop and kick", not seeing the thoughtfulness of Ashito who is going to practice alone. However, Togashi's explanation is abstract, and night training is difficult. They both irritated each other, but eventually, from the movement of Togashi, Ashito finally got a hint of "stop and kick".

10.o: In the unusual mini game of 11-on-21, Ashito completely loses the trust of Kuroda and Asari for lack of cooperation. Date gives Ashito the assignment to figure out why they got mad at him. While the others enjoy the only day off of the week, Ashito sets out to practice alone, not being able to find the answer. Then, a sudden visitor appears.

11.t: Tokyo Metropolis League Match 1 - Seikyo High School
11.o: Tokyo Metropolis League has opened. Ashito and others have their first official match against Seikyo High, but the mood of the team has been awful since the fight on the day of the entrance ceremony. The Esperion Youth B team struggles to coordinate, despite being chosen as a starter, Ashito hasn't found the answer to Date's assignment. Frustrated, Taira suggests that the first-year players switched out.

12.o: In the second half of Tokyo Metropolis League Match 1 against Seikyo High School, Ashito coordinates with Kuroda and Asari, and learns the importance of carrying the ball with three players. Having the answer to his assignment, Ashito initiates the counterattacks of the Esperion B team. As they make a comeback from the disadvantage of 0 -3, the game time is running out. In his extreme state of concentration, something strange is happening to Ashito's eyes…!

13.o: During the celebration dinner for the victorious match against Seikyo High, a soccer game comes on the TV at the BBQ restaurant, showing Kuribayashi making his J1 debut. Around the time Kuribayashi finishes his interview for his incredible play, Mibu receives a call from Date, telling him that there will be some member change between the A team and the B team, since Yoshitsune injured himself. Ashito makes some great plays at the promotion game. Will Ashito be able to move up to the A team?

14.o: Fukuda tells Ashito to change position to defender, which was not something Ashito could stomach. His teammates, wondering why Ashito didn't show up to the announcement of the A team promotion, learn the truth and feel shocked. Tachibana, Ohtomo, Togashi, Kuroda, and Asari go and look for Ashito, but he's nowhere to be found. It is Hana, who walks up to Ashito, sitting at a bus stop all by himself.

15.o: While still feeling unconvinced, Ashito makes up his mind that he must try and learn to be a full-back. He goes to practice, wanting to figure out Fukuda's intention. However, being unfamiliar to the position and disliking defending, Ashito doesn't quite get the meaning of "shuffle" and feels out of place.

16.o: Advised by Takeshima and Anri that he should study Kuribayashi's movements, Ashito pours over the broadcast of the J1 match to see Kuribayashi's play. Combing over the past footage of Kuribayashi's play, Ashito realizes that what set Kuribayashi apart is how he turns his head. Ashito tries to incorporate it in his practice right away, but it only confuses him. In his teammates eyes, that confusion looks like being unmotivated for having to play a full-back.

17.t: Tokyo Metropolis League Match 7 - Tama Sports Science University High School
17.o: Ashito and others have an unexpected reunion with Nakano and Kaneda, who played alongside him at the tryouts. After failing the tryouts for Esperion, Nakano and Kaneda joined the current top team in the league, Tokyo Musashino Soccer Club Youth, where Tachibana used to play. While Nakano is happy to see Ashito and others, Kaneda blames Ashito for his failing the tryouts.

18.o: Esperion B team has a match against Tama Sports University. Thanks to Yoshitsune, they finish the first half with one goal lead. However, Togashi and Takeshima mess up their play at the beginning of the second half and allow the opponent a goal. With Isshiki out of the game due to his injury, the B team changes the formation, and Togashi and Ashito are instructed to move upfield. Date tells Ashito to take what he learned defending and apply it to attacking.

19.o: The B team ends the match with Tama Sports U. Next match is against Musashino, currently the first place of the League and also Tachibana's old team. However, Tachibana doesn't feel confident enough to play since he hasn't had notable achievements in the League so far, and asks Date not to play him in the match against Musashino. Ashito and others bring Tachibana along to observe Musashino's game. Team Musashino, which includes Kaneda and Nakano, who played alongside Ashito at the tryouts, displays an incredible play.

20.o: Esperion B team starts to show some signs of improvement as they face undefeated Musashino in the next match. When the team needs to be united more than ever, Takeshima and Togashi, who are the key defenders of the team, have a huge fight. Tachibana, with a strong resolution that he will do anything he can to win the next match, goes to Yuma to ask him what happened between Togashi and the promoted players in the past.

21.t: Tokyo Metropolis League Match 8 - Tokyo Musashino FC Youth
21.o: The game against Tokyo Musashino is the climax of the Tokyo Metropolis League for Esperion B team. Although the team has worked on countermeasures against Musashino, the air is still tense within the team and there's a clear sign of anxiety on the faces of many of them during the warmup. But right before the game starts, Takeshima disappears from the locker room with his girlfriend, Tae.

22.o: Esperion B team bitterly allows the first goal to Muto, the playmaker of Musashino. With Musashino one step ahead, second-year Sugawara suggests that they go back to their original play style that relies on short passes. But Tachibana, Togashi, and Takeshima insist on continuing with the direct approach they've been practicing. To the disconcerted players, Date starts giving concrete instructions for a change.

23.t: Do Your Best. Don't Lose. Fight to Your Limits
23.o: The match between Esperion and Musashino will determine who will dominate the Tokyo Metropolis League. Musashino's ace, Kaneda, takes advantage of the weak coordination between Togashi and Takeshima, giving Musashino a go-ahead score. Right before the end of first half, Kuroda injures himself due to his desperate defense play. During the halftime, Asari blames the center-backs, but Date disagrees with him. Togashi has resented Takeshima for a long time, but now…

24.o: Thanks to Ashito's great bird's-eye view, Esperion B team succeeds in bringing down the defense of Musashino and scores a tie-goal. Esperion gains the momentum, while Musashino is confused by Ashito's flexible play. Kaneda can't hide his frustration at seeing just how much Ashito has improved. The desperate battle between the top of the Tokyo Metropolitan League, Musashino, and the challenger, Esperion: Who will win in the end...?

1.o: Adachi and Shimamura happened to meet each other on the second floor of the gymnasium as they were skipping class. Eventually, they started seeing each other more and started playing ping-pong together.

2.o: Shimamura meets a little astronaut named Yashiro. Shimamura and Adachi also decide to attend class for once and Adachi starts questioning how she actually feels about Shimamura.

3.o: Shimamura worries about Adachi when she doesn't come to school the next day after she abruptly left her house. The two girls go out together on the weekend and an unlikely guest joins them.

4.o: Shimamura just happens to run into Adachi's mom at the gym and they have an awkward encounter. Later on, Shimamura invites Adachi to karaoke with Hino and Nagafuji.

5.o: Adachi tries to ask Shimamura if she'd like to hang out on Christmas, but has a very hard time getting the words out. Meanwhile, Shimamura wonders why Adachi's been acting so weird lately.

6.o: Adachi asks Hino to help her find a Christmas gift for Shimamura and Adachi and Shimamura finally hang out on Christmas.

7.t: Please Choose the Best Chocolate for Me
7.o: The girls welcome the new year and Adachi seems to be acting weird again. She later tries to ask Shimamura if she'd want to hang out on Valentine's Day.

8.t: The Briar That Weaves the Past: Old Rose
8.o: Adachi tries to figure out what kind of chocolate to give to Shimamura. Later on, the girls go to Nagafuji's house to play a game.

9.t: Love That Embraces the Holy Mother: Marigold
9.o: Valentine's Day finally arrives and Adachi and Shimamura hang out as promised. But this time, it's actually Shimamura that has a surprise in store for Adachi.

10.t: Cherry Blossoms and Spring and Spring and the Moon
10.o: Adachi and Shimamura start a new school year and Adachi is nervous to see if they actually end up in the same class. They do end up the same class, but as Adachi tries to get closer to Shimamura, others get in the way.

11.t: The Moon and Determination, Determination and Friends
11.o: Adachi decides that she does want to spend time with Shimamura and builds up the courage to approach her again.

12.t: Friends and Love, Love and Cherry Blossoms
12.o: Adachi seems very adamant about wanting to spend the night at Shimamura's house.

1.o: يتم تحديد عدد دقائق اللعب لـ"ليبرون"، ويسعى "جيسون" إلى ترسيخ تاريخه الرياضي من خلال البطولة، فيما يستغل "جيمي" مواهبه المتنوعة للتميّز على أرض الملعب.

2.o: يصب "أنتوني" تركيزه على المنافسة في خضم سعيه لمستقبله المشرق، فيما يسعى "دومانتاس" جاهدًا لتحقيق التوازن بين حياته مع العائلة ومخططات مسيرته الشاقة.

3.o: تُعدّ خطط الراحة والتعافي أمرًا في غاية الأهمية للاعبين، إذ تتسبب أول بطولة لـ"كأس الدوري الأمريكي" بالمزيد من الضغوطات على مستوى المباريات الفاصلة والإصابات.

4.o: يستمتع اللاعبون بصباح يوم بهيج مع عائلاتهم قبل خوض مباريات عيد الميلاد المجيد، وهو اليوم الذي يواجه فيه "جيسون" خصمه "ليبرون" في منافسة العطلة النهائية والحاسمة.

5.o: يشتغل "جيمي" في مشروع الموسيقى الريفية، ويكتشف "دومانتاس" خبر استبعاده من مباراة كل النجوم، فيما يواجه "جيسون" ردود فعل عنيفة عقب خسارتهم أمام فريق "لايكرز" ناقص العدد.

6.o: يحقق "ليبرون" إنجازًا تاريخيًا بعد انقطاعه خلال مباراة كل النجوم، ويلعب "جيمي" رغم مشاعر الحزن التي تعتريه، فيما يستعد "أنتوني" لاستقبال مولودته الأولى.

7.o: يفكر اللاعبون مليًا في مرحلة الأبوة حين يخوض "أنتوني" مهمته الجديدة كأب. فيما تتنافس الأفرقة على أرض الملعب لضمان الصدارة والتأهل إلى التصفيات النهائية.

8.o: ينتهي الموسم لـ"دومانتاس" بمواجهة "جيمي" وفريق "هيت" لفريق "سفنتي سيكسرز" في تصفيات الأدوار الإقصائية. فيما يتألق "أنتوني" في مباراة ضد مثله الأعلى "كيفن دورانت".

9.o: مع مواجهة "ليبرون" احتمالية الإقصاء، يشتعل فتيل النقاشات بشأن الوجه الجديد للدوري. ويظل فريق "سلتكس" متصدرًا للمشهد، بينما يأمل "أنتوني" في إنهاء عهد فريق "ناغتس".

10.o: في "دالاس"، يخسر "أنتوني" في الأدوار الإقصائية. ويتقدم فريق "سلتكس" إلى نهائيات الدوري الأمريكي لكرة السلة، حيث يضع "جيسون" كل ما لديه على المحك من أجل تحقيق الفوز في أول بطولة له.

1.o: مع بدء المسير نحو نهائيات الدوري الأمريكي لكرة السلة، يعيد "تايريس" و"جايلن" و"كيفن" و"جيمس" و"شاي" إحياء المنافسات والسعي الدؤوب نحو الاستمرارية في كرة السلة.

2.o: يُفحِم "شاي" أبطال العام الماضي فيما يحاول الموازنة بين الأبوة والشهرة، ويعيد "جيمس" صياغة مبادئة الشخصية. وثمة خسارة صعبة تختبر ثقة "تايريس" بنفسه.

3.o: مع تقدُّم أحداث موسم كرة السلة، يقف نجومنا الخمسة على مفترقات طرق مختلفة، غير أنّ المجد على موعدٍ معهم... والعمل الدؤوب لا هوادة فيه.

4.o: يتأمل "جايلن" في أصوله، ويزور "شاي" مسقط رأسه في "تورونتو". وفيما تغمر أجواء العطلة المكان، ثمة صراع عالي المخاطر في الملعب يُطلق شائعات جامحة عن صفقة ما.

5.o: ثمة صفقة ضخمة تهزّ الدوري، فيما يسعى "كيفن" لتحقيق إنجاز كبير وسط زخم من الشائعات والشكوك. وفي "باريس"، يتفاقم الضغط على "تايريس" داخل الملعب وخارجه.

6.o: يتواجه "تايريس" و"شاي" في مباراة يحتمل أن تكون لمحة أولية للمواجهة النهائية. وفي ظل اقتراب فريق "بوسطن" من قمة الدوري، يحافظ "جايلن" على توازنه. أما "كيفن"، فيعاني من انتكاسة.

7.o: مع انطلاق الأدوار الإقصائية في الدوري الأمريكي لكرة السلة، يخيم الحزن على "جايلن" وفريق "سلتكس"، بينما يقود "تايريس" فريق "إنديانا بايسرز" إلى التألق ويفرض "شاي" سطوته أمام "دنفر".

8.o: من لحظات الألم وقطرات العرق وحمامات الثلج، وُلدت هذه اللحظة... عندما يصبح الإرث على المحك، يقود "تايريس" و"شاي" فريقيهما نحو صدام مشتعل للفوز بلقب الدوري الأمريكي لكرة السلة.

1.o: في عام 1995 وفي سعيهم إلى الهروب من حياتهم يخطط "كيريو" وأصدقاؤه لسرقة إحدى صالات الألعاب ولكن سرعان ما يكتشفون أن هذه الصالة تحت سيطرة عائلة "دوجيما"، وهي منظمة "ياكوزا" قوية تحكم منطقة "كاموروتشو" بقبضة من حديد. أما في عام 2005، وقبيل إطلاق سراح "كيريو" من السجن، يتلقى خبراً صادماً من المحقق "ديت" يخبره فيه أن أصدقاءه في خطر. فيقرر "كيريو" العودة إلى "كاموروتشو" لحمايتهم رغم المخاطر التي تنتظره.

2.o: في عام 1995، كان "كازاما"، الذي يدير دار الأيتام "دوار الشمس"، يأمل أن يعيش "كيريو" و"نيشيكي" و"يومي" و"ميهو" حياة نزيهة ومستقيمة، لكن على عكس ما كان يتمناه، يجد الأربعة أنفسهم في نهاية المطاف غارقين في عالم "الياكوزا" المظلم. في المقابل، وفي عام 2005، تصل التوترات بين تحالف "أومي" وعشيرة "توجو" إلى ذروتها بسبب عملية سرقة ضخمة تبلغ قيمتها عشرة مليارات ين.

3.o: في عام 1995، تقترب عائلة "دوجيما" من شقيقة "إدغار" الصغرى التي اؤتمنت بحفظ الختم الرسمي اللازم لبيع أرضه. في تلك الأثناء تسافر "يومي" إلى "أوساكا" بحثاً عن شقيقتها الكبرى. بالتزامن مع ذلك، تشتد المعركة حول ختم "إدغار" وتتصاعد الأحداث. أما في عام 2005، تختفي "أيكو" فجأة، تاركة ابنتها "هاروكا" خلفها. بينما يقرر "كيريو" و"يومي" حماية "هاروكا"، لكن سرعان ما يكتشفان سراً صادماً يغير مجرى الأمور.

4.o: في عام 1995، تسقط "ميهو"، المرهقة من العمل بسبب مرضها الخطير. بينما "نيشيكي"، الذي تملأه مشاعر القلق العميق على شقيقته، يجد نفسه ضحية لمخطط "دوجيما" الذي يستغل ضعفه وحبه لها. أما في عام 2005، وأثناء استمرار "كيريو" و"يومي" في البحث عن "أيكو" في "أوساكا"، يواجهان "غودا" رئيس تحالف "أومي"، الذي يجبرهما على التعهد بإعادة مبلغ عشرة مليارات ين بحلول منتصف الليل في اليوم التالي.

5.o: في عام 2005، يلتقي "كازاما" بـ"غودا" رئيس تحالف "أومي"، في محاولة لمنع اندلاع حرب مع عشيرة "توجو". لكن الصراع القديم الذي لم يُحسم بين "كيريو" و"نيشيكي" منذ عشر سنوات يعود ليطفو على السطح، مما يخلق فجوة جديدة بينهما. أما في عام 1995، كان "كيريو" يحقق سلسلة انتصارات في قتال الأنفاق لتمويل عملية "ميهو" الجراحية. وأخيراً، يصل إلى قمة مجده بمواجهة حاسمة في مباراة على اللقب بمخاطر عالية.

6.o: في عام 1995، تتفكك الرابطة التي جمعت "كيريو" و"نيشيكي" و"يومي" و"ميهو"، والتي كانت تجمعهم كعائلة، بشكل مأساوي. أما في عام 2005، يواجه "كيريو" معضلة كبيرة، هل سيتمكن من منع الحرب بين عشيرة "توجو" وتحالف "أومي"؟ وكيف سيحل "كيريو" و"نيشيكي" الصراع الذي مضى عليه عشر سنوات؟ وما هي الهوية الحقيقية لشيطان "شينجوكو"؟ مع تصاعد التوترات، يستعد الجميع للمواجهة النهائية في شوارع "كاموروتشو".

10.o: تواجه فرقة المهام فولتشيك بعنف لإنقاذ مدينة يسكنها ملايين البشر. وبينما ينقشع الضباب ويسعى ميتشوم جاهداً لحل مشاكله الصحية، يظهر تهديد جديد من عميل الخدمة السرية رايان فيتزجيرالد.
